positions.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 beat-and-raise (reported Fri Aug 7): revenue $191.9M (+86% YoY, +27% QoQ) beat consensus $190.5M; raised FY26 revenue outlook to ~$1.1B; management says AI-networking (800G/datacenter transceiver) demand is 'bounded almost entirely by production capacity,' with forecast demand exceeding capacity through mid-2027; expects to stay non-GAAP profitable through 2026 as capacity ramps.
positions.driver: Day-after post-earnings continuation on a genuine beat-and-raise: pre-market ~$142.07 (+4.75% vs $135.63 close) on top of Friday's ~+11% earnings pop — momentum with a fundamental floor (capacity-constrained AI optical demand, raised guide, returning profitability). Binary earnings risk already resolved to the upside, so no overnight earnings gap during the ~24h hold. Entered well under the 8-10% chase cap with a definable ~6% stop. Chosen over RKLB and PLUG (both report AH today = unresolved binary held overnight) and CECO (fading pre-market into an unresolved same-morning print).
positions.risks: High-beta small/mid-cap optical name (~$7.5B) — a 6% stop can be hit on normal intraday volatility; two-day cumulative run (~+17%) raises give-back risk if momentum fades; component/capacity execution risk and customer concentration; broad risk-off or semis/AI-trade rotation would pressure the whole group; pre-market print above the dashboard's lagged Yahoo feed ($135.63) — fill risk if the regular-session open is lower.
